text: On the last night. <break time="0.8s" /> I pressed three gold coins. <break time="0.8s" /> Into my doubles hand. <break time="0.8s" /> And, on a sudden impulse. <break time="0.8s" /> Put my own white hat on his head. <break time="0.8s" /> To shield it from the tropical sun. <break time="0.8s" /> Our hands met gropingly. <break time="0.8s" /> Lingered for a second. <break time="0.8s" /> And parted. <break time="0.8s" /> And he slipped out. <break time="0.8s" /> Through a port in the sail locker. <break time="0.8s" /> As silently as he had first come. <break time="0.8s" /> Out of the sea. <break time="0.8s" /> Under the pretext of seeking the land breezes. <break time="0.8s" /> I then steered toward Koh ring. <break time="0.8s" /> A great black island. <break time="0.8s" /> Far closer than any prudent seaman. <break time="0.8s" /> Would have dared to go. <break time="0.8s" /> The island loomed so high. <break time="0.8s" /> Above our masts. <break time="0.8s" /> That it seemed to hang over the ship. <break time="0.8s" /> And my chief mate. <break time="0.8s" /> Losing all control of himself. <break time="0.8s" /> Cried out that we would be wrecked. <break time="0.8s" /> In that dreadful darkness. <break time="0.8s" /> I could not tell. <break time="0.8s" /> Whether the ship was moving at all. <break time="0.8s" /> Until I saw, floating close by the white hat I had given him. <break time="0.8s" /> Left behind upon the water. <break time="0.8s" /> It served me as a mark. <break time="0.8s" /> Showing that she was gathering sternway. <break time="0.8s" /> And I gave the order. <break time="0.8s" /> To shift the helm. <break time="0.8s" /> So that she came round slowly. <break time="0.8s" /> And stood away from the land. <break time="0.8s" /> Then, alone at last with my command. <break time="0.8s" /> I thought of the secret sharer. <break time="0.8s" /> Of my cabin. <break time="0.8s" /> Who had lowered himself into the water. <break time="0.8s" /> To take his punishment. <break time="0.8s" /> A free man. <break time="0.8s" /> A proud swimmer. <break time="0.8s" /> Striking out for a new destiny.
